review_type: static data and source inspection only; no application execution or runtime tests

compatibility.load_examples: reads join(root,web,examples,index.json), JSON parses it and returns .apps or {}
compatibility.known_behavior_change: Existing gallery metadata becomes visible if the archived reference is manually started; inherited missing MP4 URLs remain missing.
compatibility.autoplay_boundary: No root/production entrypoint or autostart is introduced. Archived media.js itself plays visible/hover video thumbnails when manually served; do not claim autoplay is absent from that UI.
compatibility.runtime_validation: NOT RUN per current user instruction

preservation.plan: Move 19 disjoint gallery directories and original index into corresponding archived FreeField web/examples paths without altering bytes or overwriting destinations.
preservation.missing_media_policy: Do not invent/download/generate replacement MP4s or claim the gallery is complete.
preservation.rights_policy: Preservation does not approve public redistribution or model/voice/media rights.
